newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end higher, Nikkei up over 300 points.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end higher, Nikkei up over 300 points.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed higher on Monday as the yen's weakness against the dollar eased worries that a rebound in the yen after the weekend Group of Seven (G7) meeting might pull down major export-oriented issues, brokers said. Such issues have recently acted as a prop for the market.

Some also said comments by Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka that the authorities would firmly support 20 major Japanese banks in their efforts to resolve their bad loan problems aided some banking issues in the afternoon.
The key 225-share Nikkei average gained 314.13 points or 1.76 percent to close at 18,181.17.
